not_found: BOA Congress 2026 speakers page does not mark which speakers are plenary or keynote, and the full session mapping is behind the BOA App login; only a selection of 27 speakers was recorded and the last part of the page was not read.
Orthopaedic specialist societies (for example the British Hip Society, British Orthopaedic Foot and Ankle Society) and an orthopaedic nursing body were not read in this pass.
Some BOA Council members have no organisation or role detail shown on the page (affiliation left null).
LinkedIn searches were not run: the web search allowance for the session was used up, so every linkedin_url is null.
